# Budgie

> Budgie is a privacy-first, offline-first expense tracker for iOS and Android. Every transaction is stored on-device in an encrypted SQLite database — no cloud account, no aggregator, no server ever sees your financial data. Core features are free; advanced AI and bank-sync features are an optional one-time purchase. Currently in private beta with a waitlist at https://budgie.at.

Budgie's source code is publicly available under a source-available license (https://github.com/budgie-at/budgie). The app UI is available in English, Ukrainian, French, German, and Spanish.

## Home

- [Budgie — Privacy-First Expense Tracker](https://budgie.at/en): Offline-first value proposition, feature overview, on-device AI, security model, bank integrations, and FAQ.

## Key Features

- [Offline-First Expense Tracker](https://budgie.at/en/features/offline-first-expense-tracker): Core features run entirely on-device; no internet, no sign-up, encrypted local storage.
- [On-Device AI Auto-Categorization](https://budgie.at/en/features/ai-auto-categorization): A local LLM plus an on-device embedding model categorize transactions; corrections feed the local index. No cloud API.
- [Voice Transaction Entry](https://budgie.at/en/features/voice-transaction-entry): Speak an expense; on-device speech recognition transcribes it — audio never leaves the phone.
- [Monobank Auto-Sync](https://budgie.at/en/features/monobank-sync): Direct Monobank API via your personal token — no Plaid, no aggregator.
- [Net Worth Tracker](https://budgie.at/en/features/net-worth-tracker): Bank, cash, crypto, stocks, ETFs, and debt in one offline, multi-currency dashboard.
- [Spending Analytics](https://budgie.at/en/features/spending-analytics): Category/tag charts, monthly trends, and drill-down to transactions — fully offline.
- [PIN Lock + Encryption](https://budgie.at/en/features/pin-app-lock): The PIN derives the database encryption key; without it the file is unreadable.
- [CSV Import](https://budgie.at/en/features/csv-import): Import any bank's CSV with reusable column-mapping presets and deduplication.
- [Database Backup & Restore](https://budgie.at/en/features/database-backup): One encrypted backup to your own cloud storage; restore on a new device with your PIN.
- [Multi-Currency](https://budgie.at/en/features/multi-currency): Accounts in any currency with daily FX-rate refresh and cross-currency transfers.
